name: engineering-report-stack
description: Report-as-Code engineering stack with traceability, JSON Schema validation, YAML authoring, interactive WebUI rendering, and Agent Skills.

scripts.report:trace: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m report_engine.cli trace examples/demo-report REQ-EMC-001
scripts.report:impact: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m report_engine.cli impact examples/demo-report STD-DEMO-001
scripts.report:generate: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m report_engine.cli generate examples/demo-report web/generated/demo-report.md --view-model-output web/public/generated/demo-report.json --data-url ./demo-report.json
scripts.docs:dev: npm run report:generate && vitepress dev web
scripts.docs:build: npm run report:check && npm run report:generate && vitepress build web
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run docs:build
